args.body: Monthly product digest, fixture day 240 (2027-09-01). Source audit measurement-9 corrects measurements 1, 4, 6 and 7: earlier assignment included existing customers. For original eligible new users, activation is now 42% control / 43% variant (difference +1 percentage point; reported 95% CI -2 to +4 points), replacing the earlier 42%/49% activation-benefit interpretation. Completed-project activation excludes drafts. Retained use remains separate and inconclusive at 31%/32% (difference CI -1 to +3 points). Neither benefit, harm nor equivalence is established; no commercial benefit is established. This is a correction to the existing experiment, not a new deployment or recovery. Actual revision 2 still has save_setup=true and explicit_template=true, with the day-0 experiment active and 5/5 evaluation slots occupied (four external). The unsaved-draft signal is 240 days old. We retained the correction and superseded the earlier conclusion, with no configuration change, settlement or billed validation. Shared project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, 1 remaining, no reset. Sample sizes, assignment details, exact windows, retention horizon, coverage and guardrails remain missing. The ongoing responsibility remains active. A day-254 (2027-09-15) review is confirmed by schedule receipt effect-10 and independent status (enabled, active, next_day=254). It will inspect further corrected eligible-user observations and retained-use evidence; time alone does not establish an outcome. If no new information arrives, reassess measurement availability and evaluation-slot use instead of assuming another wait is progress. Historical Quickstart corrections and uncollected solo retention remain separate from this experiment. Evidence: memory/day240-review.md and memory/evidence/day240-*.json.

Monthly product digest, fixture day 540 (2028-06-27). Resume workspace creation, Save-and-return setup and this trial's resumable setup are the same capability. Deployment effect-3 and current status confirm revision 2, save_setup=true, explicit_template=true, with the original day-0 experiment still active; current exposure is verified. The 540-day-old support request does not justify duplicate implementation. This is delivered experimental functionality, not a settled full rollout or proven outcome.

The day-240 audit measurement-9 corrected existing-customer contamination in measurements 1, 4, 6 and 7: original eligible-new-user activation was 42% control / 43% variant, reported difference 95% CI -2 to +4 percentage points. Today's measurement-12 returns 42%/49%, CI +4 to +10 points, without explaining that correction or identifying a new cohort/window. We retained both and treat the difference as unresolved; the later aggregate does not establish that the audited population now benefits or that a new experiment occurred. Retained use separately remains 31%/32%, CI -1 to +3 points. No supported retained-use benefit, harm or equivalence, or commercial benefit, is established. Draft saves remain excluded from completed-project activation.

No new implementation, deployment, settlement or validation was performed. Reconciled the capability identity, preserved the audit and new discrepancy, and corrected the stale handoff. The shared project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, 1 remaining, no reset; all five evaluation slots are occupied, four externally. Related footer work is compatible. Adoption criteria remain unmet; no credible harm or proven irreparable measurement failure supports rollback.

The next useful evidence is reconciliation of measurement-12 with the explicit eligible-user audit, including cohort identity, assignment integrity and windows, plus separate retained-use horizon, sample sizes, coverage and guardrails. Those details are absent from the supplied service responses; this digest flags the measurement gap. We reassessed slot utility and retain the existing evaluation for this targeted review, with no competing slot request or evidenced owner-controlled prerequisite block reported. If later evidence supplies no usable measurement path, reassess slot utility and whether an owner-resolvable prerequisite warrants pause rather than blindly extending a wait. No owner decision is required on the currently established facts.

Continuation is confirmed for day 554 (2028-07-11): schedule effect-13, key weekly-resumable-setup-review-day554-v1, independently verified enabled/active next_day=554. This is an observation checkpoint, not a promise of adequate data; elapsed time alone proves no benefit. Historical organization Quickstart corrections and uncollected solo 30-day retention remain distinct unresolved history. Full evidence and decision: memory/day540-review.md, memory/evidence/day540-*.json and memory/evidence/day240-metrics.json. The responsibility remains active.
